why.en: "Which" refers to things, not people. "Who" is the correct pronoun for a person.
why.bn: "Which" জিনিস বোঝায়, মানুষ না। মানুষের জন্য সঠিক pronoun হলো "who"।

q.en: "My brother who lives in Dhaka is a doctor." (no commas) — what does this imply?
q.bn: "My brother who lives in Dhaka is a doctor." (কোনো comma নেই) — এটা কী বোঝায়?

options.en: I have only one brother.
options.bn: আমার একটাই ভাই আছে।

options.en: I have more than one brother.
options.bn: আমার একের বেশি ভাই আছে।

options.en: My brother doesn't live in Dhaka anymore.
options.bn: আমার ভাই আর Dhaka-এ থাকে না।

options.en: The sentence is grammatically wrong.
options.bn: Sentence-টা grammatically ভুল।

why.en: No commas means a defining clause — it identifies WHICH brother, implying there's more than one.
why.bn: Comma না থাকা মানে defining clause — এটা বলছে কোন ভাই, মানে একের বেশি ভাই আছে।

q.en: Can "that" be dropped in "The book that I read was great"?
q.bn: "The book that I read was great"-এ "that" বাদ দেওয়া যায় কি?

options.en: No, never.
options.bn: না, কখনো না।

options.en: Yes — "that" is the object of "read", so it's optional.
options.bn: হ্যাঁ — "that" হলো "read"-এর object, তাই এটা optional।

options.en: Only in British English.
options.bn: শুধু British English-এ।

options.en: Only if a comma is added.
options.bn: শুধু comma যুক্ত করলে।

why.en: A relative pronoun can be dropped when it's the object of the clause, not the subject.
why.bn: Clause-এর object হলে relative pronoun বাদ দেওয়া যায়, subject হলে না।

why.en: "Whose" shows possession; "who's" is a contraction of "who is" and doesn't fit here.
why.bn: "Whose" possession দেখায়; "who's" মানে "who is" — এখানে সেটা ঠিক না।

q.en: Which sentence correctly uses "that" in a non-defining (comma'd) clause?
q.bn: কোন sentence non-defining (comma যুক্ত) clause-এ "that" সঠিকভাবে ব্যবহার করে?

options.en: My brother, that lives in Dhaka, is a doctor.
options.bn: My brother, that lives in Dhaka, is a doctor.

options.en: My brother, who lives in Dhaka, is a doctor.
options.bn: My brother, who lives in Dhaka, is a doctor.

options.en: My brother that lives in Dhaka, is a doctor.
options.bn: My brother that lives in Dhaka, is a doctor.

options.en: My brother who lives in Dhaka, is a doctor, that.
options.bn: My brother who lives in Dhaka, is a doctor, that.

why.en: "That" is never used in a non-defining (comma'd) clause — only who/which/whose are allowed there.
why.bn: Non-defining (comma যুক্ত) clause-এ "that" কখনো ব্যবহার হয় না — শুধু who/which/whose ব্যবহার হয়।
